xiang-wei-la-jiao-xiao-chao-rou: Hunan stir-fried pork belly with chilli: thin slices of pork belly wok-seared until the edges curl, tossed with blistered long green chillies, garlic slices and fermented black beans, glossy with dark soy, piled into a neat mound
suan-tai-bao-chao-rou-si: stir-fried shredded pork with garlic scapes: fine pork strips and bright green garlic scape segments, a few dried red chilli pieces, light glossy sauce, piled loosely
suan-miao-bao-chao-rou-si: stir-fried shredded pork with green garlic leaves: pork strips with long flat green garlic leaves wilted but still vivid, a few red pepper strips
qin-xiang-chao-rou-si: stir-fried shredded pork with celery: pale pork strips with crisp pale-green Chinese celery batons and a few red pepper strips, light clean sauce
jiao-bai-chao-rou-si: stir-fried shredded pork with water bamboo shoots: ivory-white julienned water bamboo with pork strips and green pepper strips, very light sauce
bao-chao-xian-zhu-gan: spicy stir-fried pork liver: thin slices of pork liver seared brown-pink, with onion wedges, green and red pepper pieces, garlic, glossy dark sauce
hong-shao-pai-gu: red-braised pork ribs: short cut ribs braised to deep mahogany, thick glossy lacquered sauce clinging to each piece, scattered with a few spring onion greens, stacked neatly
tang-cu-pai-gu: sweet and sour pork ribs: crisp fried short ribs coated in a shiny amber sweet-and-sour glaze, sprinkled with toasted white sesame seeds
suan-xiang-pai-gu: garlic pork ribs: twice-fried golden ribs tossed with crisp golden fried garlic chips and a few dried chillies, dry glossy finish
yu-mi-pai-gu-bao: pork rib and sweetcorn soup: clear golden broth in a shallow white bowl with pork ribs, chunks of yellow sweetcorn on the cob, carrot rounds and a few goji berries
tu-dou-yu-mi-dun-pai-gu: braised pork ribs with potato and sweetcorn: ribs, soft potato chunks, sweetcorn segments and dried shiitake in a light brown braising sauce
he-lan-dou-chao-la-chang: stir-fried snow peas with Cantonese cured sausage: vivid green snow peas with translucent red-and-white slices of lap cheong sausage, glossy, garlic slices
qing-jiao-niang-rou: stuffed green peppers with pork: halved green peppers filled with pork mince, pan-seared golden on the meat side, glossy light brown sauce pooled underneath
qing-zheng-rou-wan: steamed pork meatballs: pale, smooth hand-formed pork meatballs arranged in a ring, clear glossy light sauce, tiny scattering of spring onion greens
xi-lan-hua-chao-rou-pian: stir-fried pork slices with broccoli: bright green broccoli florets with pale pork slices and a few carrot rounds, light glossy sauce
ke-jia-niang-dou-fu: Hakka stuffed tofu: rectangular tofu blocks pan-seared golden on one side, each filled with pork mince, sitting in a thin glossy brown sauce, tiny spring onion greens
